findings.title: Registered metric-alert handler is abstract and cannot be instantiated
findings.body: `MetricAlertDetectorHandler` now subclasses `StatefulDetectorHandler` but implements none of its abstract members, including `counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and `build_occurrence_and_event_data`. The class can be registered, but `Detector.detector_handler` will raise `TypeError` when it tries to instantiate it for a detector of this group type, preventing that detector from being processed.

findings.title: Document the new dictionary return type
findings.body: This docstring says `evaluate` returns a list, but the method now returns a dictionary keyed by group key. That contradicts the method’s contract and can mislead callers or handler implementers about how to consume its results; update the documentation to describe the dictionary.
